_N_info: Number of training trajectories to generate/load for each environment.
_M_info: Number of test trajectories to generate/load for each environment.
_T_info: Length (in time steps) of each generated trajectory.
_seeds_info: Random seeds for dataset generation and model training to ensure reproducibility.
_B_info: Number of bins for the MeanScaleQuantizer (vocabulary size for the tokenized time series).
_ctx_info: Context window length (number of tokens) used as input for the transformer model.
_stride_info: Stride size for extracting sliding windows from the trajectories during tokenization.
_epochs_info: Total number of training epochs for the foundation model.
_d_model_info: Dimensionality of the transformer model embeddings.
_n_layer_info: Number of layers in the transformer architecture.
_batch_info: Batch size for training the foundation model.
_H_info: Forecast horizon (number of steps to predict into the future) during evaluation.
